description: This file provides helper functions for managing autotranslation features in Mattermost, including license checks, enabling/disabling autotranslation globally and per channel, setting mock source language, and setting user preferences.

methods.name: hasAutotranslationLicense
methods.description: Checks if the server license includes autotranslation features (Entry or Advanced).

methods.name: enableAutotranslationConfig
methods.description: Enables autotranslation in server configuration with LibreTranslate provider, using provided mock URL and target languages.

methods.name: enableChannelAutotranslation
methods.description: Enables autotranslation for a specific channel.

methods.name: disableChannelAutotranslation
methods.description: Disables autotranslation for a specific channel.

methods.name: setMockSourceLanguage
methods.description: Sets the detected source language for the mock LibreTranslate server.

methods.name: setUserChannelAutotranslation
methods.description: Sets autotranslation preference for the current user in a specific channel.
